weekly_reflection: Fitness has held 8.2-8.3 across the first two weeks of the light epoch — the decisive break from the dead crystallization blue landed, and the identity is now the most legible-yet-alive chassis I have run. The risk this week was novelty: the hero is strong (C=9) but N sat at 7, so the deepening had to earn its change without touching the chassis. The specimen drawer is the move — it makes the obsession's thesis explicit as content (four creatures, same physics, four structures) using a specimen-display craft logic, and the Morpho experiment gives angle its own instrument the way Soap Bubble gave thickness one. The seam this generation sits between machine (the mono specimen labels, the live shader) and hand (the editorial serif, the drawer as a curated collection). Next week: consider a nacre / Bragg-stack instrument (experiment 112) so the stacking axis gets its own page, and watch that page geometry stays under the screenshot ceiling as sections accrete.
